name: Phoenix Food LLC
old_description: Prepare quick and delicious meals and desserts that will impress your family and guests with Phoenix Food LLC’s dry mixes. As a leading dry mix manufacturing company, we deliver great-tasting, easy-to-make soups, dinners, desserts, side dishes, and dips to millions of individuals. For over 20 years, our brands have been helping customers create memorable culinary experiences, no matter how busy life gets.
about:
Phoenix Food LLC operates from Canton, Texas, where it has spent over two decades building a portfolio of dry‑mix products. The company was founded more than 20 years ago, though a precise founding year is not publicly disclosed, and no individual founders are named in its public materials. Ownership details such as family, veteran, or woman‑owned status have not been stated.

The business manufactures a wide range of dry mixes, including soups, entrees, biscuits, breads, baking essentials, desserts, no‑bake cheesecakes, and dip mixes. It runs two consumer‑facing brands—Homemade Gourmet and Just In Time Gourmet—and also produces private‑label products for partners. The company describes its operation as a diversified dry‑mix manufacturing facility with “excellent manufacturing processes and stringent quality controls,” and notes that it offers hundreds of existing formulations.

Phoenix Food serves both retail consumers and private‑label customers across the United States. Its products are marketed to home cooks looking for quick meal solutions as well as to brands seeking a co‑manufacturer for shelf‑stable dry mixes. The company says its mixes reach “millions of individuals” and that its private‑label portfolio spans a variety of retail channels.

The company emphasizes quality ingredients, versatility, and time‑saving convenience as its core differentiators. It also positions itself as an industry leader in product quality, delivery reliability, and turnaround speed, though specific lead‑time figures are not published.
